verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a data activation platform that writes to production destinations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging workspace, or test-environment capability. Read-only API keys scoped to a viewer role, the sync-run debugger, and Git Sync are adjacent controls, not isolated testing against non-production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
